{{Top|leg}}
'''Charon venom''' was a form of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that coated the claws of individual [[Charon/Legends|Charon]]. The poison attacked a victim's central nervous system, progressively destroying the nerve cells. Victims were assailed with pain and hallucinations as they slowly [[Death/Legends|died]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alain Gryphon]], commander of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']], succumbed to the poison.
